meta.title: TLEMCENYA — Cold-extracted Sigoise olive oil, Tlemcen, Algeria
meta.description: Olive mill in Tlemcen, Algeria. Cold-extracted Sigoise extra virgin olive oil, ≤ 0.8% free acidity, traceable lots. Bulk, flexitank, tin and glass, FOB Ghazaouet.

hero.lede: We press fruit from the Beni Snous hillsides within six hours of picking, and never above 27 °C. What leaves the decanter goes into stainless tanks the same day.

variety.title: Why Sigoise
body: Sigoise is the olive of western Algeria. It grows on the limestone hillsides between Tlemcen and Ghazaouet, where summers are dry and nights are cool. That day-to-night swing concentrates polyphenols instead of diluting them.

Its flesh-to-stone ratio yields 18 to 22% under cold extraction. On the palate: raw artichoke, green almond, a clean bitterness and a pepper that stays in the throat. It holds up to heat and it does not disappear into a vinaigrette.

process.title: From tree to tank
process.lede: Six operations, in order. Each one carries a time or temperature constraint, and that is where the quality of a lot is decided.

steps.title: Picking
steps.body: Pneumatic combs and ground nets. Fruit travels in ventilated 22 kg crates, never in sacks — a sack crushes the olive and raises acidity before it reaches the mill.

steps.title: Intake and washing
steps.body: Weighing, de-leafing, cold-water washing. Every delivery is assigned a lot number that follows the oil all the way to the container.

steps.title: Milling
steps.body: Stainless hammer mill, continuous flow. The paste is formed with as little air contact as the line allows.

steps.title: Malaxation
steps.body: Forty minutes under nitrogen, 26 °C maximum. Run it warmer and you gain yield and lose aroma; we decide for aroma.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.body: Two-phase centrifugal decanter. No added water, so no polyphenols washed out and no olive mill wastewater to treat.

steps.title: Storage
steps.body: Nitrogen-blanketed 12,000 l stainless tanks at 16 °C, in the dark. Packing happens against an order, never in advance.
